ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p40/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p40/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p40/r6.claim: People who assume descent from Abraham and Moses entitles them to Paradise are condemned; Islahi redirects attention to those prophets' teachings and sacrifices.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p40/r6.anchor: Their attention is directed to the teachings and sacrifices of these prophets

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p67/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p67/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p67/r5.claim: The promise that a person’s work will be seen and repaid assures believers that even tiny good deeds count and warns that no small evil deed is ignored.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p67/r5.anchor: the believers should rest assured that the smallest of their good deeds shall be taken notice of

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p70/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p70/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p70/r1.claim: The passage adds extensions grounded in the original scriptural statement, a Qur’anic pattern that here turns the discourse from verse 40 onward into commentary on Quraysh.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p70/r1.anchor: There are several examples in the Qur’ān in which a statement is cited and then certain additions are made in it

STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r16.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r16.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r16.claim: The third section calls people to reflect on their creation and transitions to enduring truths in the scriptures of Moses and Abraham.
STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r16.anchor: the third section (vv. 31–54) calls upon people to reflect upon their creation

STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r17.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r17.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r17.claim: This section then turns to perennial truths attested in the scriptures of Moses and Abraham.
STUDYQURAN:53:intro/r17.anchor: transitions into a discussion of the perennial truths attested in the scriptures of Moses and Abraham

RAZI-FULL:v29p14#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p14#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p14#2/r1.claim: ما in 53:39 is more plausibly a verbal noun, supported by 53:40, وأن سعيه سوف يرى: the verbal noun can denote the object worked upon, as خلق الله means God's created thing.

RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r1.claim: سوف يرى means that a person's effort will be shown and disclosed: believers rejoice in seeing their good deeds, perhaps before all creatures, while the sight brings the unbeliever grief; the phrase may also mean God will see it, as in 9:105.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r1.anchor: أي يعرض عليه ويكشف له من أريته الشيء

RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r2.claim: One account says a past deed is shown in a beautiful form if it was righteous.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r2.anchor: يراه على صورة جميلة إن كان العمل صالحا

RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r3.claim: On Rāzī's theological position, it is plausible for a past deed to be seen after its occurrence because every existent can be seen and God can restore what has ceased to exist.

RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r4.claim: A figurative reading takes seeing one's kindness before a king to mean seeing its reward; Rāzī calls this remote because the next verse separately says the person will be fully requited.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r4.anchor: وهو أن ذلك مجاز عن الثواب

RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r5.claim: One parsing makes the pronoun refer to سعي: the person is rewarded for his effort; جزى can take two objects or three with a preposition, and the preposition may be omitted with the verb attached directly.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15/r5.anchor: الهاء ضمير السعي أي ثم يجزى الإنسان سعيه بالجزاء

RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r1.claim: “Then” may signal delayed recompense itself or merely the next point in the discourse; delayed recompense raises the question of why a righteous person waits.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r1.anchor: لتراخي الجزاء أو لتراخي الكلام أي ثم نقول يجزاه

RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r2.claim: There is no conflict in delaying the fullest reward: God begins rewarding the righteous from death, then reserves the most complete reward, Paradise, for later.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r2.anchor: أن الوصف بالأوفى يدفع ما ذكرت لأن الله تعالى من أول زمان يموت الصالح يجزيه

RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r3.claim: “Most complete” can mean an added reward: Paradise and, beyond it, the vision of God; this reading best fits the unrestricted superlative, since only that vision exceeds every complete reward.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r3.anchor: للذين أحسنوا الحسنى } ( يونس : 26 ) وهي الجنة : { وزيادة } وهي الرؤية

RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r4.claim: The wording about wrongdoers only denies that one bearer carries another’s burden; it does not rule out God forgiving the bearer, whereas an exception for one’s own burden would imply that it remains.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r4.anchor: في حق المسيء : { ألا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى } وهو لا يدل إلا على عدم الحمل

RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r5.claim: For the righteous, “only what he strives for” affirms that he receives what he earns; the alternative “not what he did not strive for” would not affirm that.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r5.anchor: وقال في حق المحسن : ليس للإنسان إلا ما سعى ، ولم يقل : ليس له ما لم يسع

RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r6.claim: The sinner-facing wording leaves room for hope while the righteous-facing wording dispels fear, expressing that mercy precedes wrath.
RAZI-FULL:v29p15#2/r6.anchor: وقال : في حق المسيء بعبارة لا تقطع رجاءه ، وفي حق المحسن بعبارة تقطع خوفه

STUDYQURAN:53:40/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:53:40/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:53:40/r1.claim: Everything done in life will be witnessed on Judgment Day; God judges deeds, people are shown them, and they testify to how they lived.
STUDYQURAN:53:40/r1.anchor: This verse means that everything one does in this life will be witnessed on the Day of Judgment.

STUDYQURAN:53:40/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:53:40/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:53:40/r2.claim: The verse is linked to 9:105, where the Prophet is told that God, the Messenger, and believers will see people’s deeds before their return to God for judgment.
STUDYQURAN:53:40/r2.anchor: Thus the Prophet is told to say, Perform your deeds. God will see your deeds, as will the Messenger and the believers

BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r8.claim: Saʿy means a person's work, as in the statement that people's efforts differ; all these teachings are in the scrolls.
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r8.anchor: وهو عمله كما فى قوله تعالى {إن سعيكم لشتى}

BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r9.claim: A person's effort will be shown and disclosed to him on Judgment Day in his record and on the scales.
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r9.anchor: أي يعرض عليه ويكشف له يوم القيامة فى صحيفته وميزانه

BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r10.claim: The first level is the ego's purification from religious violations and natural conformity by their opposites, yielding gardens and their delights.
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r10.anchor: واول مراتبه فى السعى مرتبة النفس وسعيه فى هذه المرتبة تزكية النفس عن المخالفات الشرعية

BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r11.claim: At the heart level, striving removes human darkness and natural veils; its result is abandoning worldly desires, pleasures, ornaments, wealth, and status.
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r11.anchor: والمرتبة الثانية والسعى فيها تصفية القلب عن صدأ الظلمات البشرية وغطاء الدورات الطبيعية

BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r12.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r12.claim: At the secret level, striving polishes the inner secret through divine attributes and lordly character, resulting in witnessing manifestations of divine attributes and names.
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r12.anchor: والمرتبة الثالثة والسعرى فيها تجلية السر بالصفات اللالهية والاخلاق الربانية

BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r13.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r13.claim: At the spirit level, striving brings essential theophanies and true witnessing; its result is extinction of ego and subsistence in absolute oneness.
BURSEVI:v9p206#2/r13.anchor: المرتبة الرابعة والسعى فيها تجلية الروح بالتجليات

BURSEVI:v9p207/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p207/r1.speaker: الواسطي
BURSEVI:v9p207/r1.claim: Al-Wāsiṭī says striving is not a means by which one can obtain any reward.
BURSEVI:v9p207/r1.anchor: إنه لم يكن مما يستجلب به شيء من الثواب

BURSEVI:v9p207/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p207/r2.speaker: سهل
BURSEVI:v9p207/r2.claim: Sahl says a person will see that his striving is unfit for God and learn what it deserves; without his Lord's grace, he would perish through it.
BURSEVI:v9p207/r2.anchor: سوف يرى سعيه فيعلم أنه لا يصلح للحق ويعلم ما الذي يستحق بسعيه

BURSEVI:v9p207/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p207/r4.speaker: الوراق
BURSEVI:v9p207/r4.claim: Al-Warrāq maps striving to beginning, middle, and end; at the end, annihilation is rewarded with witnessing and subsistence with bodily nurture, including lawful provisions deferred during the path.
BURSEVI:v9p207/r4.anchor: قالل الوراق : وإن ليس للإنسان إلا ما سعى ذلك في بدايته وإن سعيه سوف يرى

TABATABAI:53:40-43/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:53:40-43/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:53:40-43/r2.claim: The effort is the person’s deeds, which will be seen on Judgment Day; the recompense context makes the timing clear, as in verses where deeds are made present and seen.
TABATABAI:53:40-43/r2.anchor: المراد بالسعي ما سعى فيه من العمل وبالرؤية المشاهدة وظرف المشاهدة يوم القيامة بدليل تعقيبه بالجزاء

TABATABAI:53:40-43/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:53:40-43/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:53:40-43/r3.claim: The passive ‘will be seen’ suggests that someone besides the deed’s performer will observe it.
TABATABAI:53:40-43/r3.anchor: لا يخلو من إشعار بأن هناك من يشاهد العمل غير عامله

TABRISI:53:31-41/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:53:31-41/r11.speaker: ابن عباس والسدي والكلبي وجماعة من المفسرين
TABRISI:53:31-41/r11.claim: They report the passage about ʿUthmān: after his foster brother ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Sarḥ promised to bear his sins if he stopped donating, ʿUthmān gave him a camel and ceased giving; it says he left his post at Uḥud, then resumed his former practice.
TABRISI:53:31-41/r11.anchor: فعاد عثمان إلى ما كان عليه عن ابن عباس والسدي والكلبي وجماعة من المفسرين

TABRISI:53:40-41/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:53:40-41/r5.speaker: author
TABRISI:53:40-41/r5.claim: A person's deeds and efforts will later be seen, meaning the person will be recompensed for them.
TABRISI:53:40-41/r5.anchor: يعني أن ما يفعله الإنسان ويسعى فيه لا بد أن يرى فيما بعد

TABRISI:53:40-41/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:53:40-41/r6.speaker: author
TABRISI:53:40-41/r6.claim: Then the effort itself is repaid in full: lasting reward for obedience, with the pronoun referring to the effort; on Judgment Day the servant sees it and receives its fullest recompense.
TABRISI:53:40-41/r6.anchor: والهاء في يجزاه عائدة إلى السعي والمعنى أنه يرى العبد سعيه يوم القيامة

THALABI:v9p154/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p154/r1.speaker: أبو بكر الوراق
THALABI:v9p154/r1.claim: Al-Warrāq takes striving to mean intention, supported by the report that people are raised according to their intentions.
THALABI:v9p154/r1.anchor: قال أبو بكر الوراق: إلا ما سعى أي نوى، بيانه قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «يبعث الناس على نياتهم»

THALABI:v9p154/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p154/r2.speaker: author
THALABI:v9p154/r2.claim: A person's striving will be shown, then he will receive the fullest recompense.
THALABI:v9p154/r2.anchor: وأن سعيه سوف يرى ثم يجزاه الجزاء الأوفى

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69/r1.claim: Yurā is passive of “I showed him”; the striving will be seen at the Resurrection, meaning the deeds will be visible in the balance, as Muqātil and al-Zajjāj say.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69/r1.anchor: يرى من أريته الشيء، والمعنى أن سعيه يرى يوم القيامة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69/r2.speaker: ابن قتيبة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69/r2.claim: Ibn Qutayba reads yurā as “will be known,” meaning people will know the person’s striving.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p69/r2.anchor: وقال ابن قتيبة {يرى} يعلم، والمعنى يعلمه الناس

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:53:36-44/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:53:36-44/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:53:36-44/r5.claim: A person's work, both good and evil, will be seen in his balance.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:53:36-44/r5.anchor: وأن سعيه } عمله { سوف يرى } في ميزانه من خير وشر

ELMALILI:53:33-54#2/r14.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:53:33-54#2/r14.speaker: author
ELMALILI:53:33-54#2/r14.claim: A person's striving will be seen in the record and placed on the scales at the Resurrection; its fruit is not necessarily immediate, but the effort is not lost.
ELMALILI:53:33-54#2/r14.anchor: kıyamet günü defterinde görülecek ve mîzânına konulacaktır. Yani sa‘yi boşa gitmez, fakat onun semeresini peşin ve fi’l-hâl görmeye kalkışmamalıdır.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:53:36/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:53:36/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:53:36/r4.claim: Every deed chosen in worldly life will be brought before the person at the Resurrection; good and bad will be seen and judged with complete justice.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:53:36/r4.anchor: Dünya hayatında iradî seçimle yaptığı her iş mahşer günü insanın önüne konacak, iyilik ve kötülükleri görülecek

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:53:36/r7.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:53:36/r7.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:53:36/r7.claim: These verses also affirm the value before God of honest effort and earning through one’s own labor.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:53:36/r7.anchor: dürüstlükle çalışıp çabalamanın, alın teriyle kazanmanın Allah nezdindeki değerine de işaret etmektedir

SULAMI:v2p288#3/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p288#3/r1.speaker: الواسطي
SULAMI:v2p288#3/r1.claim: The Prophet’s striving was not a means by which he sought to obtain reward.
SULAMI:v2p288#3/r1.anchor: قال الواسطي رحمة الله عليه : إنه لم يكن مما يستجلب به شيئا من الثواب

SULAMI:v2p288#3/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p288#3/r2.speaker: أبو حفص
SULAMI:v2p288#3/r2.claim: One who sees the defects and shortcomings of his work dislikes being recalled for it and disowns its attribution to himself.
SULAMI:v2p288#3/r2.anchor: وقال أبو حفص : من نظر إلى آفات عمله والتقصير في مواجبه كره أن يذكر به

SULAMI:v2p288#3/r3.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p288#3/r3.speaker: سهل
SULAMI:v2p288#3/r3.claim: When he sees his striving, a servant recognizes that it is unfit for God and what it merits; without his Lord’s grace, that striving would perish.
SULAMI:v2p288#3/r3.anchor: قال سهل : سوف يرى سعيه فيعلم انه لا يصلح للحق ويعلم ما الذي يستحق لسعيه

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r1.speaker: author
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r1.claim: One image, a flint striking sparks, can branch into several comparisons: a generous person, a keen mind, success, and attaining one’s aim.
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r1.anchor: الزند بإيرائه يعطيك شبه الجواد والذكى الفطن وشبه النجح في الأمور والظفر بالمراد

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r2.speaker: author
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r2.claim: A flint that fails to spark can suggest a miser, a dull person whose mind yields nothing, or someone whose effort comes to nothing.
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r2.anchor: وبأصلاده شبه البخيل الذي لا يعطيك شيئا والبليد الذي لا يكون له خاطر ينتج فائدة

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r3.speaker: author
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r3.claim: The moon can suggest a person’s fame, distinction, honor, and elevation, as well as completion after deficiency and decline after fullness.
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r3.anchor: ويعطيك من القمر الشهرة في الرجل والنباهة والعز والرفعة ويعطيك الكمال عن النقصان

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r4.speaker: author
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r4.claim: Abu Tammam uses the growing crescent to picture a noble child developing until he resembles his distinguished origin in merit and intellect.
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r4.anchor: إن الهلال إذا رأيت نموه أيقنت أن سيصير بدرا كاملا

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r5.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r5.speaker: author
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r5.claim: Al-Buhturi compares a rise from one rank of honor to a higher one with a crescent gradually becoming full.
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r5.anchor: مثل الهلال بدا فلم يبرح به

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r6.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r6.speaker: author
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r6.claim: An unnamed poet compares a person’s life to the moon: growth reaches fullness, then old age brings decline and disappearance.
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r6.anchor: المرء مثل هلال حين تبصره يبدو ضئيلا ضعيفا ثم يتسق

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r7.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r7.speaker: author
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r7.claim: Ibn Babak likens a minister’s partial share in royal authority to the moon midway through its growth; the verse praised Abu Ali after Fakhr al-Dawla appointed him vizier.

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r8.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r8.speaker: author
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r8.claim: Abu Bakr al-Khwarizmi’s couplet contrasts a host’s long stays when wealthy with his brief visits when poor.
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p114/r8.anchor: أراك إذا أيسرت خيمت عندنا مقيما

TUSTARI:53:40/r1.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:53:40/r1.speaker: author
TUSTARI:53:40/r1.claim: A person will see that their striving is unfit for God and learn what it merits; without God's grace, that striving would perish.
TUSTARI:53:40/r1.anchor: سوف يرى سعيه ويعلم أنه لا يصلح للحق ويعلم الذي يستحقه سعيه، وأنه لو لم يلحقه فضل الله

JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r1.speaker: author
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r1.claim: Words do not differ in merit as isolated sounds or single lexemes; their excellence comes from how each word's meaning fits the words beside it.
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r1.anchor: أن الألفاظ لا تتفاضل من حيث هي ألفاظ مجردة

JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r2.speaker: author
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r2.claim: The word أخدع is graceful in examples by al-Hamasa and al-Buhturi but burdensome in Abu Tammam, showing that a word's effect depends on its context.
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r2.anchor: ومن التنغيص والتكدير أضعاف ما وجدت هناك من الروح والخفة

JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r3.speaker: author
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r3.claim: The word شيء sounds apt in lines by Umar ibn Abi Rabi'a and Abu Hayya but weak in al-Mutanabbi's line about the rotating heavens.
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r3.anchor: الفلك الدوار أبغضت سعيه لعوقه شيء عن الدوران

JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r4.speaker: author
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r4.claim: If excellence belonged to a word by itself, it would remain good or bad in every setting; its changing effect shows that arrangement with neighboring words creates merit.
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p54/r4.anchor: فلو كانت الكلمة إذا حسنت حسنت من حيث هي لفظ

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p429#7/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p429#7/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p429#7/r1.claim: He glosses the person’s saʿy as his deed or work.

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p429#7/r2.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p429#7/r2.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p429#7/r2.claim: He explains “will be seen” as “will be known.”

MAJAZ:v2p238/r3.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v2p238/r3.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v2p238/r3.claim: Saʿyahu means his work or deed.

NAHHAS:v4p276/r10.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p276/r10.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p276/r10.claim: On the Day of Resurrection people will see their good and bad deeds and be recompensed for them.
NAHHAS:v4p276/r10.anchor: أن يظهر الناس يوم القيامة على ما عمله من خير أو شر لأنه يجازى عليه

NAHHAS:v4p276/r11.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p276/r11.speaker: أبو إسحاق
NAHHAS:v4p276/r11.claim: Abu Ishaq says the construction is permissible, though Kufans forbid it because they see two governors acting on the same noun.
NAHHAS:v4p276/r11.anchor: قال أبو إسحاق ويجوز ( وأن سعيه سوف يرى ) قال وهذا عند الكوفيين لا يجوز منعوا أن زيدا ضربت

NAHHAS:v4p276/r12.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p276/r12.speaker: الخليل
NAHHAS:v4p276/r12.claim: Al-Khalil, Sibawayh and their associates, along with Muhammad ibn Yazid, allow the construction.
NAHHAS:v4p276/r12.anchor: وأجاز ذلك الخليل وسيبويه وأصحابهما ومحمد بن يزيد

NAHHAS:v4p276/r13.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p276/r13.speaker: محمد بن يزيد
NAHHAS:v4p276/r13.claim: Asked why he permits anna Zaydan ḍarabtu while rejecting Zayd ḍarabtu, al-Mubarrid says anna necessitates an omitted pronoun because the clause has two governors.
NAHHAS:v4p276/r13.anchor: هذا مخالف لذاك لأن إن لما دخلت اضطررت إلى إضمار الهاء لأن في الكلام عاملين

SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r2.claim: Both وأن clauses may be genitive, nominative, or accusative through coordination with the preceding أن.
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r2.anchor: ومحلها الجر أو الرفع أو النصب لعطفها على أن قبلها، وكذلك محل

SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r3.claim: On the passive reading, يُرى can mean visually seen; this is clearer than the knowledge sense, which requires an omitted second object.
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r3.anchor: مبني للمفعول فيجوز أن يكون من البصرية أي: يبصر، وأن يكون من العلمية

SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r4.speaker: الزجاج
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r4.claim: Al-Zajjāj permits active يُرى with an elided ه, yielding سوف يراه, as Makki reports.
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r4.anchor: وقال مكي: " وأجاز الزجاج " يرى " بفتح الياء على إضمار الهاء

SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r5.speaker: الكوفيون
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r5.claim: The Kufans disallow the active reading because it would make both أن and يرى govern سعيه.
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r5.anchor: ولم يجزه الكوفيون لأن سعيه يصير قد عمل فيه " أن " و " يرى "

SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r6.speaker: المبرد
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r6.claim: Al-Mubarrad and others allow active يرى with an elided object pronoun, since أن governing سعيه signals the pronoun; Basrans analogize إن زيدا ضربت.
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r6.anchor: وهو جائز عند المبرد وغيره؛ لأن دخول " أن " على " سعيه " وعملها

SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r7.claim: The author says only أن governs سعيه while يرى governs its implied pronoun; تنازع and اشتغال do not make this double government.
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r7.anchor: وهذا توهم باطل لأنا نقول " سعيه " منصوب ب " أن " ، و " يرى "

SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r8.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r8.claim: Abu al-Baqāʾ reports the active فتح reading as anomalous and weak because it leaves the noun of أن without a predicate.
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r8.anchor: وقد حكى أبو البقاء أنه قرىء به شاذا، ولكنه ضعفه من جهة أخرى فقال: " وقرىء بفتح الياء وهو ضعيف

SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r9.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r9.claim: The author rejects calling سوف يراه far-fetched: the pronoun can return to striving itself, and the Kufan conclusion may be right for another reason.
SAMIN-DURR:53:39-40/r9.anchor: ثم أي بعد في تقدير: سوف يرى سعي نفسه؟ وكأنه اطلع على مذهب الكوفيين

ZAJJAJ:v5p76/r1.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p76/r1.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p76/r1.claim: Although God already knows every deed, the servant will see his own deed on the Day of Resurrection in his balance.
ZAJJAJ:v5p76/r1.anchor: فالمعنى أنه يرى العبد سعية يوم القيامة، أي يرى في ميزانه عمله

ZAJJAJ:v5p76/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p76/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p76/r3.claim: Zajjāj allows سوف يرى but prefers يرى; إن زيدا سوف أكرم is weak because إن and أكرم both govern the noun, though an implicit pronoun such as سوف يراه or إن زيدا سأكرم resolves the issue.
ZAJJAJ:v5p76/r3.anchor: وجائز أن تقرأ سوف يرى، والأجود يرى. لأن قولك إن زيدا سوف أكرم، فيه ضعف لأن إن عاملة وأكرم عاملة

ASAD-NOTES:53:38#n33/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:53:38#n33/r1.speaker: Asad
ASAD-NOTES:53:38#n33/r1.claim: A person's striving will be seen on Judgment Day, when God will make people understand all they did in life.
ASAD-NOTES:53:38#n33/r1.anchor: when - as the Qur'an states in many places - God "will make you [truly] understand all that you were doing [in life]"

ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#2/r1.claim: His effort will be shown and disclosed to him on Judgment Day in his record and scale.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#2/r1.anchor: يعرض عليه ويكشف له يومالقيامة في صحيفته وميزانه

ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p67#2/r2.claim: The form is from araytuhu al-shayʾ, I showed him the thing; the display brings glad tidings to the good-doer and rebuke to the evil-doer.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p417/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p417/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p417/r1.claim: A person's striving will be shown on the scale on Judgment Day; the wording is derived from making someone see an object.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p417/r1.anchor: {وأن سعيه سوف يرى} في ميزانه يوم القيامة، [مأخوذة] (2) من: أريته الشيء.

BAYDAWI-FULL:53:39-46/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:53:39-46/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:53:39-46/r2.claim: A person's effort will be shown and then repaid with the fullest recompense.
BAYDAWI-FULL:53:39-46/r2.anchor: وأن سعيه سوف يرى ثم يجزاه الجزاء الأوفى

BIQAI-FULL:v7p330/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p330/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p330/r2.claim: Every good and evil effort will certainly be seen; the passive leaves the viewer unspecified because being seen itself brings pleasure or shame, whoever the viewer is.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p330/r2.anchor: ولما كان الاطلاع نفسه مرضيا أو مخزيا لا بالنسبة لأحد بعينه , بناه للمجهول بقوله : { يرى * }

DURR-FULL:v7p661/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p661/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v7p661/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says the Prophet would recite these verses, then say the istirjaʿ formula and become subdued.
DURR-FULL:v7p661/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا قرأ {وأن ليس للإنسان إلا ما سعى وأن سعيه سوف يرى ثم يجزاه الجزاء الأوفى} استرجع واستكان

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r2.claim: The clause may coordinate with 38 and remain within the earlier scriptures; emphatic أن suits the report that a person's effort will be displayed, a consequence of his having only his own effort.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r2.anchor: فلما كان لفظ { سعيه } صالحا للوقوع اسما لحرف { أن } زال مقتضي اجتلاب ضمير الشأن فزال مقتضي ( أن ) المخففة .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r3.claim: Because saʿy itself can serve as the subject of أن, the clause needs no pronoun of شأن and therefore no reduced أن.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r3.anchor: فلما كان لفظ { سعيه } صالحا للوقوع اسما لحرف { أن } زال مقتضي اجتلاب ضمير الشأن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r4.claim: Alternatively, the clause is not part of the earlier scriptures: it coordinates with the relative ما under the preposition bi and says people were not told this truth.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r4.anchor: ويجوز أن لا يكون قوله مضمون قوله : { وأن سعيه } مشمولا لما في صحف موسى وإبراهيم فعطفه على ( ما ) الموصولة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r5.claim: Sawfa marks future time and most often suggests a distant future.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r5.anchor: و { سوف } حرف استقبال والأكثر أن يراد به المستقبل البعيد .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r6.claim: At reckoning, efforts may be embodied as visible deeds or identified by signs, as in the light preceding believers; a banner is assigned to each traitor.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r6.anchor: ومعنى { يرى } يشاهد عند الحساب كما في قوله تعالى : { ووجدوا ما عملوا حاضرا } ( الكهف : 49 ) ، فيجوز أن تجسم الأعمال

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r7.speaker: النبي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r7.claim: A hadith describes a banner raised for each traitor on Judgment Day, identifying his betrayal.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p138/r7.anchor: وما في الحديث ( ينصب لكل غادر لواء يوم القيامة فيقال : هذه غدرة فلان )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r1.claim: Effort may be made publicly known, as in the exchange about those barred from God's mercy; here seeing is a metaphor for certain, widespread knowledge.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r1.anchor: فتكون الرؤية مستعارة للعلم لقصد تحقق العلم واشتهاره .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r2.speaker: النبي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r2.claim: The Prophet said God will make public anyone who publicizes something disliked about his brother.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r2.anchor: وكما قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ( من سمع بأخيه فيما يكره سمع الله به سامع خلقه يوم القيامة )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r3.claim: Public display honors good-doers with a good reputation and makes wrong-doers suffer disgrace through an evil report.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p139/r3.anchor: وحكمة ذلك تشريف المحسنين بحسن السمعة وانكسار المسيئين بسوء الأحدوثة .

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p206#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p206#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p206#2/r1.claim: These clauses are coordinated to the initially understood أن in verse 38; the majority read fatḥa, while Abū al-Sammāl reads kasra from verse 42 onward.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p206#2/r1.anchor: وقوله بعد ذلك وأنه، وأنه معطوف كل ذلك على أن المقدرة أولا في قوله: «أنه لا تزر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r3.claim: The person will be present at Resurrection; God and those witnessing the event see his effort.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r3.anchor: وقوله: يرى فاعله حاضر والقيامة، أي يراه الله ومن شاهد الأمر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r4.claim: Public presentation of deeds honors those who did good and rebukes wrongdoers.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r4.anchor: وفي عرض الأعمال على الجميع تشريف للمحسنين وتوبيخ للمسيئين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r5.speaker: النبي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r5.claim: The Prophet said whoever broadcasts what his brother dislikes will have God broadcast him before creation at Resurrection.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p207/r5.anchor: ومنه قول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «من سمع بأخيه فيما يكره سمع الله به سامع خلقه يوم القيامة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82/r1.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82/r1.claim: Ibn Qutaybah says the person will come to know his effort.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82/r1.anchor: أحدهما سوف يعلم قاله ابن قتيبة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82/r2.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82/r2.claim: Al-Zajjāj says the servant will see his deeds on his balance on the Day of Resurrection.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p82/r2.anchor: والثاني سوف يرى العبد سعيه يوم القيامة أي يرى عمله في ميزانه قاله الزجاج

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p465#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p465#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p465#2/r1.claim: A person's deeds will be seen on Judgment Day, as in 9:105; God will inform people of them and repay them fully, good for good and evil for evil.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p465#2/r1.anchor: أي: يوم القيامة، كما قال تعالى: {وقل اعملوا فسيرى الله عملكم ورسوله والمؤمنون

JISHUMI:v9p6661/r15.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6661/r15.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v9p6661/r15.claim: One view says a person's striving is seen written in his ledger.
JISHUMI:v9p6661/r15.anchor: وأن سعيه سوف يرى قيل: يراه مكتوبا في ديوانه

JISHUMI:v9p6661/r16.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6661/r16.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v9p6661/r16.claim: A second view says its recompense will be seen on Judgment Day.
